notes.title: Future plans
notes.content:
1: TPS game with Rin as the main character, "Rin Bang Bang" may be released as a free DLC game? 
This is NOT a promise.

2: The phenomenon that the enemy's bullet hits the wall, but the hero's bullet runs through the wall.
Looking at the current global achievement data, the game seems to be just the right level of difficulty. There is no plan to fix this.

3: About the opinion that it is tired to run by pressing the shift key.
In version 2.00, the main character runs a little faster.
But I want you to enjoy hiking.
At night, you can turn on the flash light with the "F" key. 
Turn off the flash light with the "G" key.
There are no plans to fix this either.

4: Trivia
Plants (grass and flowers) differ from place to place.
Different places fly different kinds of birds.
All AI is handmade.(may pale in comparison to assets)
The cast motion of Rin, etc is also handmade.

notes.title: Bug Fixes, Big Bug, Future Prospects
notes.content:
A major newly discovered bug.
AYA does not appear when you return to the menu screen and load the hiking map again.
There is no problem until you start the game and complete it. The problem is when you load the map again.
This bug is probably due to the introduction of a drive-stage(bonus content), which is either uncorrectable or time-consuming to fix.
If we decide that it will cause inconvenience to our fans, we will consider to stop selling this application.
If it stops selling, the game will remain in your library, but it will not be updated, which is one of the benefits of Sonic-Alpha.
Please be careful if you are planning to purchase this game.
We are terribly sorry.

Summary of bug fixes
Fixed STEAM achievements to work correctly.
Fixed a bug that caused the game to stop if AYA died after being revived.
Corrected the problem of fellow chanting ancient magic despite AYA's death.
Fixed a bug where Aya's HP was not maximized when trying to play the hiking map again.
